card.name: Words just before a length of time
card.fires_on: Small words or spaces right before an expected number of years, months, or days, such as 'for' or 'another' ahead of a span. Also fires on the gap after 'approximately' before a time figure.

modes.label: Linking word before a span
modes.description: 'for', 'in' or 'another' that leads into a count of years or days.
modes.example: no more palindrome dates will happen<< for>> another 711 years until the

modes.label: Space before a number of months
modes.description: The space after 'approximately' just before a time quantity such as 6 months.

modes.label: Dose duration
modes.description: 'for' before a number of treatment days in a dosing table.
modes.example: Prophylaxis Dosage<< for>> 10 days* Volume of Oral

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward age and duration words, such as 'aged', 'age', and 'thirty years'.
card.plain: It lights up on the little word just before a length of time, like 'for' ahead of '40 years'.
